runs.name: smoke

checks.name: S1 exact-search recall agrees with the analytic model (|z| <= 4.5)
S2 Hopfield(beta=8192) equals exact search wherever the best score is unique (noise 0.3)
S2 Hopfield(beta=8192) equals exact search wherever the best score is unique (noise 0.4)
S2 float32 JAX Hopfield agrees with a float64 NumPy reference (>= 99% identical predictions)
S3 f32/bf16(acc32)/int8/popcount kernels all select a maximal-score pattern
S4 every kernel in the N sweep selects a maximal-score pattern
S5 exact-search recall in the FlyHash comparison matches the analytic model
S5 every WTA code has exactly k active units
S6 VSA decode accuracy matches the closed-form prediction for every (D, k)
S7 scatter/gather SDM is bit-identical to the dense-mask SDM
S8 partial_0.5 is indistinguishable from known-25%-noise (AUROC of max_cos within [0.45, 0.55] and CI contains 0.5)
S9 fault-free exact recall matches the analytic model at the chosen operating point
S11 JAX sparse-accumulate kernels match the NumPy reference

findings: Noisy recall: 67% of the (N, noise) cells have an analytic error probability below 1e-9, so only 33% can separate methods.
Exact vs Hopfield at N=64, noise 0.4 (exact recall 0.992): paired difference -0.008 [-0.023, +0.007], McNemar p=1, 0.8% of queries differ -> no detectable difference.
Exact vs Hopfield at N=256, noise 0.4 (exact recall 0.969): paired difference -0.016 [-0.037, +0.006], McNemar p=0.5, 1.6% of queries differ -> no detectable difference.
Kernels at N=1024, Q=64: speed relative to f32_highest: f32_default 0.88x, bf16_acc32 0.56x, bf16_bf16out 0.51x, int8_acc32 1.51x, packed_popcount 1.78x; popcount memory is 0.031x of f32.
Scaling: 0% of N-sweep rows are within 5x of the dispatch floor (11 us); best achieved 217 GFLOP/s and 3.5 GB/s at N up to 2048.
Single-request latency (Q=1, f32): device_resident: p50 803 us (p99 needs >=100 samples); host_roundtrip: p50 1051 us (p99 needs >=100 samples).

FlyHash vs controls at N=256, 30% flips: exact_flat 1.000, fly_gauss_m2048_k64_f16 0.750, fly_m2048_k64_f16 (v1) 0.781, simhash_512b 0.992. v1 FlyHash code: bitmap 256 B, index list 88 B, entropy bound 51 B, against 64 B for the raw input.
VSA at D=1024: decode accuracy stays >= 0.9 up to k=29 bundled pairs and falls below it at k=79; tuple-level record accuracy 1.000-1.000.
SDM: best configuration reliably (>=90% exact) stores 20 patterns; its memory per reliable pattern is 115x-115x that of a flat bit-packed store.
SDM: 2/3 noisy-cue cells return output with more bit errors than the cue.
OOD chimera family AUROC: max_cos 0.30, margin_top1_top2 1.00, neg_entropy 0.89, logsumexp 0.13 (0.5 = chance).

Fault injection: first significant degradation of exact search (severity): bitflip 0.05, stuck_zero 0.25, stuck_pos 0.25, dead_rows 0.05, dead_cols 0.25, gauss_static 0.5, lognormal_gain 0.3, read_noise 0.05, adc_bits 5.0.
Sparse accumulate: N=256: sparse 0.733 ms vs dense 0.105 ms; N=1024: sparse 0.53 ms vs dense 0.549 ms.
